domain_context: Campus P2P Resource Sharing Mobile App (real-time)
archetype: Vibrant Indigo / Clean Light (2023 modern mobile app)
design_rationale: Converted from the original monochrome 'Swiss' look to a vibrant, friendly 2023 app aesthetic: bright white surfaces, a confident indigo-blue primary, soft elevation shadows, generous rounding (rounded-3xl/4xl), colorful status accents, and fluid Framer Motion micro-interactions. The goal is a 'top-app' feel that still reads as trustworthy for a campus marketplace. Indigo (not purple gradients everywhere) keeps it premium rather than AI-slop. Status colors stay semantic and obvious.

typography.anti_pattern_rule: Strictly NO Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Space Grotesk.

usage_rules.h1: Outfit, font-extrabold, tracking-tight, text-3xl on mobile; use .text-gradient for accent words.

spacing_and_layout.strategy: Mobile-first, max-w-2xl content column. Cards use generous padding and rounded-3xl. Prefer soft shadows (shadow-soft/card/pop) + 1px borders over heavy borders.
spacing_and_layout.radii: Cards rounded-3xl (1.5rem) / rounded-4xl (2rem); inputs & chips rounded-2xl/full; buttons rounded-full.
spacing_and_layout.shadows: shadow-soft (subtle), shadow-card (resting elevation), shadow-pop (modals/hover), shadow-glow/-sm (brand CTAs).

patterns: Page transitions: AnimatePresence keyed by pathname in Layout (fade + slide).
Lists/grids: staggered rise-in via per-item delay; AnimatePresence popLayout for live add/remove.
Active nav + segmented controls: shared layoutId sliding pill.
Skeleton shimmer for loading; toast spring slide-in.

components.shared_kit: src/components/ui.js — Button, IconButton, Input, Textarea, Select, Card, SectionHeader, Chip, Avatar, StatusBadge, UrgentBadge, StarRating, Spinner, PageLoader, EmptyState, LiveDot, Modal.

bottom_tab_bar.style: Floating glass pill with sliding gradient active indicator (layoutId).
bottom_tab_bar.classes: fixed bottom-4 inset-x-4 max-w-md mx-auto glass rounded-full h-16 shadow-pop

catalog_item_card.style: Elevated rounded-3xl card, hover lift, gradient placeholder, glass category chip, owner trust rating, live 'New' highlight ring.

status_badges.style: Pill with colored dot + soft tinted bg per status.

qr_scanner_lender.style: Immersive full-screen camera with dark scrim, corner brackets, animated scan line, success/error full-screen states.

qr_display_borrower.style: High-contrast white QR card with brand ring inside a bottom-sheet Modal.

realtime.transport: Server-Sent Events (SSE). Frontend EventSource at GET /api/events?token=JWT.
realtime.backend: backend/realtime.py (in-process Broadcaster) + backend/routers/events.py (stream). Routers publish on state changes.
realtime.client: src/lib/realtime.js — connectRealtime/disconnectRealtime, useRealtimeEvent(type, handler), useRealtimeStatus(). Wired in AuthContext.
realtime.behavior: Catalog auto-refreshes & highlights new/returned items; transaction & dashboard pages update live for both parties; notifications push a live toast + badge; moderation queue updates for admins. Actions still go through REST; SSE is server->client push only.
realtime.scaling_note: Single-worker in-process fan-out. For multi-worker/horizontal scale, replace the Broadcaster internals with Redis pub/sub (public API unchanged).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: White on brand-gradient CTAs is accessible; keep body text on #0F172A.
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: Preserve all existing kebab-case data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use the shared ui.js kit and Tailwind tokens (brand-*, status-*, shadow-soft/card/pop/glow, rounded-3xl/4xl). Do not reintroduce raw bg-ink CTAs.
Primary CTAs use the brand gradient; secondary uses white surface + border.
Keep Outfit for headings and IBM Plex Sans for body.
For new server state changes, publish the appropriate SSE event so all clients stay live.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion; keep animations subtle and spring-based.
